answer: Hold a live summit where every identity must stay present in a randomly reassigned breakout room, answering follow-ups in real time like a falcon tracking a moving target. One operator behind fifty identities cannot attend fifty rooms at once: missed reassignments prune the copies. Willow branches — each room splits and re-merges unpredictably — so no script can pre-position answers, and sustained presence, not paperwork, becomes the scarce proof.
